items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Sy told me that when he joined your band--Trent's band

ctx.x: I imagine; yeah. I know he was a fighting kind of guy.
That was the reason that I play as high as I do on the trombone today, because--Sy never could play very much trumpet--
No, I know he wasn't, he was a fair trumpet player.
